name: ernestdefoe/trust-levels
description: Trust Levels: members earn trust by taking part, the way Discourse does it. Five levels from New to Leader, set by days visited, reading, replies and likes; each level unlocks more, new accounts get limits that make spam useless, and posts the community flags are hidden at once.

suggest.flarum/likes: Likes given and received count toward levels
suggest.flarum/flags: Spam defense: reported posts are hidden and new authors put on hold
suggest.flarum/suspend: Suspensions count against Regular; Confirm spam suspends
suggest.flarum/approval: A New member's first posts wait for approval
suggest.flarum/mentions: A per-level limit on people mentioned in a post
suggest.flarum/messages: A per-level limit on private messages a day
suggest.flarum/gdpr: Trust data in exports, erased and reset with the account
suggest.fof/upload: Attaching files opens at a level you choose
suggest.fof/user-bio: Members on hold can't edit their bio
suggest.ernestdefoe/docket: Crowd moderation weighs each reporter by level
suggest.ernestdefoe/gatehouse: A new member put on hold goes back to the approval queue
suggest.ernestdefoe/sleuth: A member linked to a banned account stays New
suggest.ernestdefoe/ladder: Ranks members see, kept apart from trust levels
suggest.ernestdefoe/buzz: "Ana is now a Regular" in the activity feed

scripts-descriptions.test:setup: Sets up a database for use with integration tests. Execute this only once.
